events.label: Lynda La Plante six-month driving ban

slots.name: driving ban
slots.sentence: Best-selling crime author Lynda La Plante has been disqualified from driving for six months, despite tearfully telling the court a ban would end her writing career.

slots.name: speeding offences
slots.sentence: She pleaded guilty on Monday to breaking the 20mph speed limit near her home in Kingston-upon-Thames five times between November 2025 and April this year.

slots.name: licence points
slots.sentence: The court heard she already had nine points on her licence, from three speeding offences in June 2023 and then June and July 2025.

slots.name: court fine
slots.sentence: La Plante was fined £3,330 and given a six-month ban because the total points on her licence had risen to 24.
